desc: Derive and prove the exact greedy feasibility formula for a target score \(X\), including visit requirements and movement costs.
Determine how to handle the first index entered from position \(-1\), intermediate indices, and the last index without overcounting moves.
Design an \(O(n)\) feasibility check compatible with \(n\le5\cdot10^4\) and \(m\le10^9\).
Establish safe binary-search bounds and integer-overflow protections for the Python implementation.
Validate the formula against both examples and edge cases such as \(m<n\), \(X=0\), and very large point values.
